source_protocol: Matbench MP formation energy, same target convention as training
selection: SHA256(20260928:id), no model outputs or energy labels used in selection
exclusion: all 11264 medium development IDs and their reduced compositions; canonical structure hash cross-check
overall_estimand: uniform deterministic sample from formula-disjoint remaining original fold0 test; not full in-distribution population
relative_estimand: 200 repeated exact-count compositions, max 8 structures/group; enrichment explicit, separate from overall MAE
pretraining_overlap: unknown, not claimed independent of foundation pretraining
prior_use_boundary: not used by the evaluated medium fine-tuning, calibration, composition fitting or development; public dataset may have appeared in unrelated historical benchmarks
checkpoint_selection: original validation absolute MAE only, min across 20 epochs, patience 8
candidate_policy: base, archived direct adaptation, fractions-only hT, archived val-selected alpha fractions-only, matched A/B/C; no confirmation grid search
relative_bootstrap: whole exact-composition groups; same resample for paired differences
prior_attempts: interventions/ and logs/ A/B/C first-seed runs started before this freeze, interrupted and excluded; formal runs use interventions_v2/
